title: [GMCP 203.028.03] Integration: Secrets, credentials, and cryptographic lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-028-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: MCP credentials and private keys live in OS-backed secret storage or an explicit encrypted fallback, are referenced rather than copied into configs, and follow creation, least-scope, rotation, revocation, export prohibition and secure deletion policies. Secret scanning, redaction canaries and crash/core-dump tests prove secrets do not enter arguments, logs, traces, task files, environment inheritance or diagnostics. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
